en.title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Drop June 25: Rockstar Confirms Price and Bonuses
en.summary: The wait is almost over for Grand Theft Auto VI as Rockstar Games has officially announced pre-order details. Get ready to secure your copy of the highly anticipated title with confirmed pricing and exclusive bonuses.
en.body:
The gaming world has been on the edge of its collective seat, and the anticipation for **Grand Theft Auto VI** has reached fever pitch. Rockstar Games has finally pulled back the curtain on crucial pre-order details, confirming that fans can officially place their orders starting June 25, 2026. This marks a significant milestone, moving the monumental title from a distant dream to a tangible reality on the horizon.

The latest information shared by Rockstar confirms a new standard for AAA game pricing, with the base edition of **GTA 6** set to retail at $79.99 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. This represents a notable jump from the $70 price point that became common this generation. For those seeking the ultimate experience, the **GTA 6 Ultimate Edition** will be available for $99.99, promising an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and narrative-driven content woven throughout the journeys of protagonists Lucia and Jason.

Rockstar has also detailed the enticing preorder bonuses that await early adopters. Any pre-orders and purchases made before November 20, 2026, will include the **Vintage Vice City Pack**. This special collection is described as a nostalgic nod to "when the neon burned brightest," offering players a taste of classic Vice City vibes. Furthermore, digital preorders will sweeten the deal with a complimentary month of **GTA+**, providing an extra layer of value for those who commit early.

For players eager to jump into the action the moment it becomes available, digital pre-orders will allow for pre-loading starting November 12, 2026. This ensures that players can seamlessly launch into **GTA 6** on its official release date of November 19, 2026, without any delay. While **GTA 6** is confirmed as a single-player experience, the implications for a future **GTA Online** remain a subject of much speculation, with its launch likely separate from the main game’s release.

## A Dual Protagonist Era Begins

The official cover art reveal for **Grand Theft Auto VI** offered a clear confirmation of what many had speculated: the game will feature dual protagonists. The imagery prominently features **Lucia** and **Jason**, signaling a narrative direction that could offer fresh perspectives and dynamic storytelling possibilities within the familiar chaotic landscape of Vice City. This move towards dual leads is a significant evolution for the **Grand Theft Auto** series, potentially allowing for more complex character arcs and gameplay mechanics.

## Community Buzz and Pricing Concerns

The confirmation of pre-order dates and pricing has ignited fervent discussion across the gaming community. While excitement for **GTA 6** is undeniably sky-high, the $79.99 price point has sparked debate. Many fans acknowledge the immense scale and ambition of Rockstar's titles, justifying the cost. However, this increase also raises questions about the future pricing of blockbuster games. The prospect of a new **GTA Online** potentially launching later adds another layer to player anticipation, with many hoping for an experience that builds upon the successes of its predecessor.

## What's Next

With pre-orders officially opening on June 25, 2026, players should keep a close eye on digital storefronts and select retailers. Further details regarding the specific contents of the **Vintage Vice City Pack** and the full scope of the **Ultimate Edition** are expected to emerge as the launch date approaches.

content_raw: It’s been a big day of GTA 6 news, with Rockstar confirming fresh details for what is perhaps the most anticipated video game of all time ahead of preorders going live. IGN has plenty of coverage for you to dig into, but here we’ve rounded up everything announced and confirmed, including new screenshots, first details on the editions, and even a new (very short) in-game video. GTA 6 price Rockstar has confirmed the GTA 6 price is $79.99 for the base game on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S . The Ultimate Edition (more on that soon), costs $99.99. This marks a jump from the $70 standard established this generation, and may open the floodgates to more games going for $80. GTA 6 preorders GTA 6 preorders start at midnight local time on June 25 . You’ll be able to put your money down from then. GTA 6 is a single-player game Rockstar has said GTA 6 is a single-player game , which suggests any new version of GTA Online will miss the launch in November. The GTA 6 Ultimate Edition The GTA 6 Ultimate Edition includes an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story, and will be available for $99.99. We’ve got more on exactly what you get here . GTA 6 preorder bonuses All GTA 6 preorders and purchases before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack, a collection of items “that flash back to when the neon burned brightest,” Rockstar said, alongside a free month of GTA+ for digital preorders. There’s more on what the Vintage Vice City Pack includes here. GTA 6 preload Players who pre-order digital versions of GTA 6 will be able to begin pre-loading on November 12, 2026 to ensure they are able to play at launch on November 19, 2026. GTA 6 physical version The physical version of GTA 6 includes a download code inside the box only , which has shocked some fans and caused others to say it’s the final nail in the coffin for the video game disc . The physical version will be available starting November 12, 2026 to support pre-loading, Rockstar said. GTA 6 screenshots Rockstar released more than 60 new screenshots showing off GTA 6, its characters, world and some retro Vice City vibes. Check them out here . GTA 6 short in-game video As Rockstar did when it announced the GTA 6 preorder date, today’s news comes with a new short video embedded within the GTA 6 website, that reveals a fresh look at the actual game. We see Jason and Lucia by a car next to a sandy beach, ready for action.
